summary: VEON Ltd. filed a 6-K announcing its subsidiary VEON MidCo B.V. launched a tender offer to purchase up to USD 750 million of its outstanding 3.375% Senior Notes due 2027, which have an outstanding principal of USD 1,013,973,000. Concurrently, VEOMidCo initiated investor meetings for a potential dual-tranche USD notes offering (5-year non-call 2 and 7-year non-call 3). Net proceeds from the offering will fund the tender and any remaining amounts will support debt reduction and general corporate purposes. The transaction is part of ongoing capital structure optimization. Watch for tender results, pricing, and issuance terms.
